question: Are there any assets — doesn't matter if it's stocks, crypto, or forex — that just had a golden cross (50-day crossing above 200-day)?

defects.desc: No forex (.FOREX) golden crosses appear in results — forex 50/200-day MA crosses are rare/absent. Not a clear defect but worth noting that Currency universe produces no golden-cross hits in this 30-bar window, effectively excluding that asset class from the answer.
